desc: The BCM Reece-9 tactical pistol features a black SBA3 pistol brace, Mod 3 pistol grip, Quad Rail QD Sling Swivel Mount, BCMGUNFIGHTER Charging Handle, Mod 1 7.62 Compensator, black Hardcoat Anodized aluminum receivers and fire Controls marked SAFE and SEMI. Made in the USA. Includes magazine, cable lock, USGI manual and FET.
